# A monthly budget that works

A budget fails when it is a wish list; it works when it describes what money actually does.

## Pay yourself first

Move savings out on payday, before anything else is spent. What stays in the account is what can be spent.

## Weekly check

Ten minutes every Sunday to look at what went out. Small leaks, like unused subscriptions, show up fast.
